description: This is a shell script testing the behavior of the 'git -C <path>' command-line option, verifying its effects and interactions with other options such as --git-dir and --work-tree, through a series of test cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a given description.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository at the specified directory.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script.
